notes: Send to TikTok: the caption replaces the file name TikTok writes in the description, instead of going after it. Hashtags become TikTok's own tags, picked from its list.
Send to TikTok: fixes TikTok Studio showing "Something went wrong" after the video was sent.
Send to TikTok: also fills in the caption and hashtags ProfitLens wrote. You add the product and AI label, and press Post.
Find a video: fixes creators' videos not playing in ProfitLens after a search.
Campaigns: reads what you nominated into each campaign and whether Shopee approved it, for ProfitLens.

Find a video: ProfitLens can search creators in TikTok Affiliate Center and fetch a pasted link for Duplicate, in a background tab, when you ask. Send to TikTok opens TikTok Studio with a video ready for you to post.

TikTok videos: reads each video's play link from TikTok Seller Center (Analytics → Video) so ProfitLens can play creators' videos that tiktok.com shows as a blank page on a computer. After each run, and when you open such a video in ProfitLens. Read-only.

TikTok campaigns: also reads each campaign's own price rules from its Criteria tab (e.g. "Campaign price must be at least 20% off the retail price") so ProfitLens prices your products to fit them. Read-only.

Campaign nomination: ProfitLens can now ask Seller Centre which of your products a session will take (the same check as Add Products) before you nominate, and shows why not for the rest - out of stock, already nominated, or already waiting in Pending Submission. Read-only.
Campaign nomination: when Shopee will not take some products for a session, says why in Shopee's own words (it used to say only "not eligible", which was a guess).

TikTok campaigns: reads the campaigns your TikTok shop can register for (TikTok Seller Center → Campaigns) and sends them to ProfitLens, after each run and when you press Read now in ProfitLens. Read-only: it never registers a product or accepts a campaign's terms. Chrome now also needs to open seller-my.tiktok.com.

Campaign nomination: your price is now set one variation at a time - Shopee was taking only one variation per product and leaving the rest at its own price. The check afterwards also read the wrong part of Shopee's answer and said "Shopee has nothing" for variations that were nominated; it now reads them correctly.

Campaign nomination: after setting your prices, reads Shopee's Nominated tab back and says exactly which variations are not at your price or stock, instead of reporting done. Campaign stock 0 means Shopee's No Limit (nothing set aside).
Campaign nomination: Shopee refused it (HTTP 403) because Seller Centre signs its own requests. The nomination requests are now made by the Seller Centre page itself.

Campaign nomination: ProfitLens's campaign sign-up can now nominate the ticked products in Shopee for you, at your prices and stock, after you confirm in ProfitLens. It stops if anything else is waiting in Pending Submission, or if a price is above Shopee's limit. It never withdraws or deletes a nomination.
CPM Voucher Hack: checks the voucher codes against the ones your shop already has before creating anything, so a product sold on two listings no longer stops at the first voucher.

CPM Voucher Hack: ProfitLens's Campaign Planner can now create a product voucher series (4 vouchers, 3 days each, quantities 3-6-9-12 or 2-4-6-8) in Seller Centre for you, after you confirm the preview in ProfitLens. It only ever creates new product vouchers - it never edits, ends or deletes any voucher.
